simulation.mood_training_coupling_note: When false (default), daily_training_hours and mood are generated independently so within-astronaut correlation is ~0 (demonstrating Simpson's/pooling fallacy). When true, daily_training_hours positively influences daily mood within each astronaut.

cost_matrix.description: Rows = true class, Columns = predicted class [Normal, Stress_BP_Spike_No_Medical_Danger, Health_Warning, Medical_Danger_Alert]. Missed Medical_Danger_Alert costs 25x-40x more than a false alarm.

tiered_alerting.description: Tier 1 ('Danger – confirm'): moderate calibrated probability (>=0.22), requests immediate sensor re-measurement. Tier 2 ('Danger'): high calibrated probability (>=0.45) OR moderate probability persisting across >=2 consecutive days.
